annotations.title: Add a document to an offer

description: Add a document to an offer. Needs `bookings:write`. Two calls. The first changes nothing: it checks the arguments as the change would (a field this tool does not take is refused, by name) and answers a summary and a confirm_token. Show the summary to the person; only after they agree, call again with the same arguments plus confirm_token.

acceptance_type.description: What the client does with it on DJfindr: view it, tick it, or sign it.

confirm_token.description: Leave out on the first call. On the second call, the confirm_token the first call answered.

content_html.description: Custom text, as HTML (with `name`), or the text kept of an uploaded PDF (convert_document).

file_id.description: A ready `proposal_document` upload of mine (a PDF).

name.description: The document's name. Defaults: a template's title; an upload's file name.

template_key.description: A document template (list_document_templates), with `values` for its placeholders.

values.description: Template placeholder to value, such as { "{{LATE_FEE_PERCENTAGE}}": "10" }.

name: add_document
title: Add a document to an offer
